change: Cached CUDA PKDA uses the full-row fused FP32 convolution, SiLU, and QK normalization with raw projected history and one final Q/K/V cast.
cause: The separate autocast convolution rounded weights and intermediate activations to BF16 before SiLU and QK normalization, unlike the full-row fused kernel.

focused_probe.method: Execute the unchanged decode_parity function extracted from cuda_gate without the rest of the integrated probe.

invariants: raw projected history with exact values at matching GEMM partitions
focused_tests.local: python -m pytest tests/test_model.py -q -k 'cached or initialization or base_init'

scope: Focused numerical and cache-state verification; no training-quality or performance claim.
